nilah.why: Formless Blade converts crit chance into lethality and its own damage scales with crit chance/damage (stat-conversion plus crit-interaction), and a hit empowers her attack speed for 4s; casting it during Slipstream adds a second wave whose connection needs a positional assumption. R is a 1-second channel that locks out attacks and other casts while it ticks, and E is a 2-charge dash that resets her attack timer.
